Support Copilot

A customer-support assistant built from scratch. It finds the right passages in a knowledge base and answers from them, so replies stay grounded. Dense (Qdrant) and keyword (BM25) search are merged with reciprocal rank fusion, which let me cut retrieved context from top-4 to top-2. If the Gemini API fails, it falls back to a local Phi-3 model on Ollama.

TripWeaver AI — Intelligent Travel Planner

An AI-powered travel planner that turns a traveller’s preferences and budget into a practical trip plan. I built a multi-agent workflow with specialized destination, budget and itinerary agents, parallelized destination and budget tasks with Python’s ThreadPoolExecutor, and used route-aware planning with transportation cost estimates to help keep recommendations aligned with the budget.

Research

94.5%detection accuracy in standard lighting, with better low-light results

Secure Edge-AI Surveillance: A Distributed Architecture Using YOLOv8 and AES-GCM for Privacy-Preserving Intrusion Detection

Published in Hinweis Science and Engineering, Vol. 3, Issue 1, January 2026. I co-authored this paper and worked on the software side, not the edge hardware. It studies AI-based intrusion detection with YOLOv8 and FaceNet, plus image preprocessing and AES-256-GCM encryption to protect biometric data. The pipeline was tested in standard and low-light conditions, where CLAHE and gamma correction improved accuracy in the dark.
